title: Mangekyo Eye Help
body:
Syntax: help <eye technique>

Description: Your individual Mangekyo eye technique helpfiles appear after you awaken the eye and successfully use its technique for the first time. Kamui's three techniques share one eye, so using any one reveals all three pages. Undiscovered pages stay out of the help index. Immortals can view every eye helpfile for testing.

Date: 2026-09-27
